response.justification: Bogdan has a strong background in geospatial data platforms and building high-performance, low-latency distributed systems, which aligns well with the industry and operational requirements of the role. However, his primary systems programming experience is heavily focused on DLang rather than the required modern C++ or Rust, and he lacks direct experience with routing algorithms or navigation guidance pipelines. He could be a viable candidate if the team is willing to allow him time to ramp up on the specific tech stack and routing domain.
strengths: Extensive experience developing geospatial data platforms and GIS applications.
Proven track record of building high-throughput, low-latency distributed microservices.
Strong commitment to software quality, demonstrated through extensive testing and TDD advocacy.
concerns: Lacks recent professional experience with C++ or Rust, heavily favoring DLang and TypeScript.
No specific experience mentioned with routing algorithms or navigation data pipelines.
Only brief historical experience with C/C++ development (7 months in 2014-2015).
